title: Parking Lot: Pricing Strategies and Concurrency
description: Add hourly rates, discounts, peak pricing, and thread-safe parking operations.

data.text: Extend the parking lot to support hourly rates per vehicle type, weekend surcharges, and concurrent entry/exit from multiple gates.
Use the Strategy pattern so pricing rules can change without modifying ParkingLot. This follows the Open/Closed principle.

data.title: Pricing Strategy and Implementations

data.text: Multiple gates can call ParkVehicle and Exit simultaneously. Use locks around spot assignment and ticket dictionary updates.

data.title: Concurrent Parking Lot
Why Strategy Pattern?
data.text: Pricing rules change frequently (hourly, daily, event-based, loyalty discounts). Strategy lets you add new rules without touching ParkingLot, keeping it closed for modification but open for extension.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Strategy pattern decouples pricing from parking logic
ReaderWriterLockSlim allows concurrent reads, exclusive writes
Ticket.Close() is the only mutation point for billing
Compose strategies: wrap Hourly with WeekendSurcharge
data.takeaway: Extensible pricing and thread safety make the parking lot production-ready. Prefer composition over inheritance for cross-cutting rules.
